HowItWorks.heading: Three fronts in one single operation

HowItWorks.pillarBiTagline: See the metrics and insights that truly matter.

HowItWorks.itemClientsDescription: Clients, sales pipelines, deadlines, and tasks in one unified hub, with full relationship history, account ownership, and smart notifications — tailored to your workflow with Bitrix24 or a proprietary CRM.
HowItWorks.itemLawsuitsDescription: Advanced agents built with LangChain and monitored with LangFuse, seamlessly connecting communication channels, databases, and enterprise APIs to handle demands with speed and precision.

About.heading: Technology forged in practice to transform the market
About.paragraph1: TechTie was born as the technology and innovation arm of BMD Holding, conceived by Dr. Bruno Durão based on a solid background of over 18 years of corporate leadership and market experience. The starting point was DAP Advocacia — the group's most renowned and prestigious law firm —, where high operational demand and complex legal workflows demanded the creation of our first product: a bespoke legal CRM for lawsuit tracking, rigorous deadline control, and critical workflow automation.
About.paragraph2: The solution eliminated manual spreadsheets, connected departments, and decisively boosted DAP Advocacia's productivity, proving on the front line the transformative power of intelligent software and data engineering. That success became TechTie's core mission: delivering proven, battle-tested technological solutions and high-caliber professionals to drive real, scalable impact across high-performance enterprises.
About.paragraph3: Today, we specialize in agentic artificial intelligence with LangChain and LangFuse, Business Intelligence dashboards, and end-to-end full-stack software development (PostgreSQL, Supabase, Next.js, React, Node.js, Python, Flutter, Firebase, and Bitrix24). High-level technology built by operators for companies that demand tangible results.
About.stackHeading: End-to-end modern technology for high-scale operations
About.stackDescription1: Our infrastructure combines autonomous AI agents built with LangChain and LangFuse, high-availability databases, and fluid interfaces crafted in Next.js and Flutter.
About.stackDescription2: Every technology is selected to guarantee enterprise security, execution speed, and native integration with your core business ecosystems.
About.codeLawHeading: Software built by people who master both the code and the law.
About.codeLawSubheading: Automation, artificial intelligence, and management systems for companies, firms, and institutions that cannot afford to get the business rules wrong.
About.codeLawParagraph1: Complex systems fail when the people coding them don't understand the rule they're automating. That's why we pair developers with years of experience with the legal and business insight of Dr. Bruno Durão, lawyer and entrepreneur, to deliver solutions that work in practice and hold up under audit.
About.codeLawItem2: Artificial intelligence applied to legal and operational workflows
About.codeLawParagraph2: Every delivery goes through validation and sign-off against the client's business rules before going live.
